narrative.overview: This document describes the effective styling of `b-refined` only. It preserves variant B's transit diagram identity: delivery phases are stations and services are connected routes. It does not replace the wider brand kit or change root product context.
keyCharacteristics: Cool map ground and dark enamel signs.
Service-owned route colors and circular interchange marks.
Equal English and Arabic editions, displayed one language at a time.
Lighter panels, calmer weight and more space within the incumbent composition.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Show the selected language alone, with Arabic RTL and Latin product names preserved.

rules.name: The Whole Route Rule
rules.body: Fit the complete desktop artwork to available viewport space; keep signs, stations and branches together.

dos: Do preserve service inks, station geometry and equal EN/AR support.
Do validate the entire route at short desktop heights as well as narrow widths.
Do keep generated imagery captioned as conceptual.
donts: Don't treat this edition's layout refinements as a replacement for the global brand system.
Don't turn concept imagery into client or product evidence.
